stem: The number of eagles seen per hour in a certain location has the distribution $\text{Po}(1.8)$. The number of vultures seen per hour in the same location has the independent distribution $\text{Po}(2.6)$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that, in a randomly chosen hour, at least 2 eagles are seen.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the probability that, in a randomly chosen half-hour period, the total number of eagles and vultures seen is less than 5.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.stem: Alex wants to be at least 99% certain of seeing at least 1 eagle.
parts.text: Find the minimum time for which she should watch for eagles.
